trial_title: Blood Flow Measurement Using Quantitative Magnetic Resonance Angiography and Duplex Sonography
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to assess the correlation of blood flow measurement in cervical and intracranial arteries between quantitative magnetic resonance angiography (qMRA) and duplex sonography (DS) and inter-/intra-investigators reliability of both methods in common clinical practice. A total of 21 subjects indicated to qMRA or DS for suspicion of cervical or intracranial vascular pathology will be included.
